calculation.power_ceiling_kw: For each active connection use the smaller of the allocated charger output and a known vehicle inlet limit. If the vehicle limit is unavailable, use the allocation as the charger-side ceiling. Sum active connections that serve the same vehicle.
calculation.output_energy_ceiling_kwh: Multiply the power ceiling by the usable charging minutes divided by 60.
calculation.scope: Illustrative constant-rate ceilings at the connector output. The source describes charger and vehicle configurations. These checks do not use observed session traces or estimate battery taper, conversion losses or queue time.
calculation.unknowns: Keep other allocations unresolved. For example, the transit report describes one and three active connectors.
